title: The Guy Who Got $1 Billion for One Day

scenes.subtitle: Ravi: Okay... either I'm a billionaire, or my bank has completely lost it.
Max: DO NOT SPEND IT. Ravi: Too late. I just ordered a mansion.
Ravi: Mansion? Bought. Sports car? Bought. Private jet? Absolutely bought.
Max: You spent HOW much? Ravi: Relax. I still have... nine hundred million.
Bank: Your $1 billion deposit was an error. The funds will be reversed.
Ravi: Maybe I can return the jet? Max: You can't return a jet, Ravi.
Ravi: Fine. At least I still have forty-seven dollars.
BANK: Monthly account fee applied. Ravi: ...I hate banks.

scenes.title: 24 HOURS LATER...
scenes.subtitle: Narrator: Ravi's bank account survived for 24 hours. His dignity did not.
